style: Authentic 16-bit SNES-era side-view action platformer game art in crisp pixel art: hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, 1-pixel dark outlines on characters, 4-tone cel shading lit from the upper left, limited palette. Setting: a ruined industrial foundry tower at night, purple-blue moonlight and molten orange glow. No text, letters, numbers, logos or UI anywhere.

clauses.rivet: The hero is Rivet, a small original robot: a big round off-white dome helmet with a wide glowing cyan visor slit across the eyes (no face visible, no fin, no forehead gem), a stubby antenna with a bolt on top, small orange cheek lights; slim dark navy body with teal armour plates held on by visible rivets and bolts; one oversized teal pipe-shaped arm cannon with an orange heat vent on the right arm, a normal mechanical left hand; chunky teal boots.
clauses.talon: The boss is Talon, a lean raptor-like robot dinosaur: deep purple and dark gunmetal armour with magenta-red accent lights, one big glowing red eye in a narrow wedge-shaped head, big hooked silver claws on hands and feet, a long segmented tail ending in a curved blade, red exhaust fins on its back.
clauses.sheet: A sprite sheet on a fully transparent background: every frame is the same character at exactly the same size and scale, facing right, evenly spaced in a neat grid with clear empty gaps between frames, nothing overlapping, no shadows on the ground, no background, no grid lines.
clauses.isolated: Fully transparent background, every item separate with clear empty space around it, no ground, no shadow, no frame.

assets.prompt: Animation frames for the hero, 4 rows of 6 frames. Row 1: 2 idle frames (slight breathing), then 4 run frames. Row 2: 2 more run frames, jump rising, jump peak, falling, landing crouch. Row 3: wall slide (back against a wall on the right side, sparks at the feet), wall jump kick-off, ground dash (low lean, thruster flame from the boots), air dash, hurt (recoiling, flashing), standing while firing the arm cannon straight forward. Row 4: running while firing (2 frames), jumping while firing, charging the cannon (cyan energy swirling around the cannon, 2 frames), victory pose.

Animation frames for the boss, 3 rows of 4 frames. Row 1: idle stance (2 frames), crouching wind-up before a pounce with the eye flaring brighter, mid-air pounce leap with claws forward. Row 2: clinging vertically to a wall on the right side with claws (2 frames), firing a red energy bolt from its mouth while clinging, diving downward diagonally with claws first. Row 3: low tail sweep along the ground, throwing a spinning claw disc, staggered and damaged with sparks, collapsing and exploding.

Twelve bolt-on robot parts for a small teal robot hero, each a separate item in a 4x3 grid, side view, gunmetal grey with a coloured stripe. Row 1 (green stripe, leg parts): big spring-coil boots, compact hover-jet thrusters for the calves, sleek dash boots with heel thrusters, and a spare item: a small wrench icon. Row 2 (orange stripe, arm-cannon attachments): a three-barrel splitter muzzle, a long rapid-fire coil barrel, a crystal pierce lens muzzle, and a backpack heat sink. Row 3 (yellow and cyan stripes): a glowing chest reactor overclock core, a round bubble-shield generator, a reboot battery with a lightning bolt, a dish-shaped scanner antenna for the helmet.

A tileset for the foundry arena, laid out as separate pieces: a long horizontal steel girder catwalk platform with yellow-black hazard striping on top and cross-bracing below; a square riveted dark steel wall block (seamless tileable); a riveted steel floor block with a lit top edge (seamless tileable); a molten metal pool surface block glowing orange; a vertical steel pillar segment; a hanging chain with a crane hook; a small furnace vent glowing orange.

The far parallax background layer of the arena: the hollow inside of a giant ruined foundry tower at night, seen from the side, low contrast and slightly hazy so foreground sprites stand out. Distant scaffolding, smokestacks and broken skylights with a purple-blue moonlit sky, faint molten orange glow rising from below, drifting steam. No platforms in the foreground, no characters.

Effect sprites for the game, separate items in a grid: a small cyan-white energy pellet shot, a medium charged shot, a large fully-charged cyan plasma blast with a trail, a cyan muzzle flash, a red enemy energy bolt, a spinning silver claw disc, a small orange explosion in 3 stages, a large explosion, a white hit spark, a dust puff from landing, a green health capsule pickup, an orange ground shockwave.
